1) We need a phased/staggered evidence handoff rather than one big bulk transfer — our audit team prefers to consume discrete artifacts over 3 weeks.

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear asks. High level response below; I included a proposed 3-week phased handoff and a preliminary capacity/price note. Happy to walk through this on a quick call.

Proposed evidence handoff (phased, weeks A/B/C):
- Week A: System-level artifacts (SOC 2 attestation copy, control maps, configurations), and an initial bulk of redacted config snapshots.
- Week B: Operational evidence (audit logs export for the selected timeframe, key rotation records, access reviews).
- Week C: Sampling artifacts (sampleed request traces, KV cache snapshots for retention verification), plus final attestation checklist.

We can stage exports as incremental zipped snapshots so your auditors can pull in each deliverable. We'll host interim packages in a shared Drive folder and provide checksums.

Retention request: We support 12 months by default; we can enable a 13-month retention carveout for Brightline as a term amendment. That will require mapping the additional storage to a committed seat uplift — estimate below.

Capacity/seat uplift estimate (preliminary):
- Current committed seats: 10 (baseline throughput for production).
- Proposed uplift: +20% peak tokens -> equivalent to adding 2 seats with buffer.
- Monthly incremental seat fee (ballpark): $3,200/seat/mo -> ~$6,400/mo extra before discounts.
- One-time evidence handling fee for phased transfer: $1,500 (covers orchestration, export, and checksum verification).

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment at Redwood on final cost + retention mapping (cc'ing Kimberly for pricing approval and Laura for attestation ops).
2) Kickoff call w/ your audit team to lock artifacts and week-level windows.
3) DocuSign amendment for the 13-month retention + seat uplift if you sign before Jan 10 to lock current list pricing.

I'll attach an evidence index + a small log snapshot to show export format.

Thanks — talk soon,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
